notes.title: Intruder on the Bridge patch notes.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045352/62a7a72a0302488df4dd050caa3344c7049adfd5.png[/img]

Dear players, we have patched several minor bugs in the game such as the lack of translation of a part of the walkthrough, a bug in the activation of the walkthrough and a bug for the unlocking of an end-game achievement.

Game link [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1700550/Intruder_on_the_Bridge/]here[/url].

notes.title: Intruder On The Bridge HOT FIX!
notes.content:
[h1]HOT FIX![/h1]
[h2]V1.0.6[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045352/683e74656648e1dc154ed645ecedbf1007cba747.jpg[/img]

We thank you for yours reports and we have taken them into consideration. We have fixed the following problems:

-Improved all English translations.

-Fixed all graphic problems present in non-Latin characters.

-Fixed various bugs and glitches in the Spanish and French languages.

Keep following us for new content!

tags.bug: -Fixed all graphic problems present in non-Latin characters.
-Fixed various bugs and glitches in the Spanish and French languages.

notes.title: HOT FIX! V1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]HOT FIX![/h1]
[h2]V1.0.3[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045352/62a7a72a0302488df4dd050caa3344c7049adfd5.png[/img]

We are happy to see that you appreciate our product so much. We are working on an update that will solve any problem our users may have found including problems with Russian, French, Korean languages, problems with interaction with some game features, problems with some graphics. 

We thank you for yours attention to detail and yours reports and we have taken them into consideration, in fact we have fixed the following problems:

-We have fixed all kinds of bugs in the French and Spanish languages.

-We realize that Captain Dyce's body is not the same in all scenes. We have fixed some discrepancies between game images with new renderings.

-We have added a 'back' button in the pause menu for a smoother UI(However you can press the 'backspace' key as a 'back' function).

-Fixed a bug for which it was very complicated to seduce Miranda Call in her final scene.

-We recognize that in the FPS minigame there is an inconsistency with the VN regarding the location of Captain Dyce's weapon. We believed this could be a 'non-sense' fact that would not create problems in gameplay. Thanks to yours report we placed the weapon in the character's inventory and no longer collectible. We have also made the UI of the minigame more intuitive.
